relations.subject: Frank Lee Woodward
relations.evidence: He joined the traditional English public school Christ's Hospital (the Bluecoat School), London in 1879

relations.subject: Frank Lee Woodward
relations.evidence: Woodward won a scholarship to Sidney Sussex College, Cambridge at the age of eighteen and won the distinction as a classical scholar... He received BA in 1893 and MA in 1902

relations.subject: Frank Lee Woodward
relations.evidence: He received BA in 1893 and MA in 1902

relations.subject: Frank Lee Woodward
relations.evidence: Woodward began his teaching career at Rugby Preparatory School, where he served for a short period as an assistant master.

relations.subject: Frank Lee Woodward
relations.evidence: Later he taught for three years at the Royal Grammar School, Worcester until 1897 as classics master.

relations.subject: Frank Lee Woodward
relations.evidence: Woodward then joined Stamford School, Lincolnshire, where he served for five years as the second master.

relations.subject: Frank Lee Woodward
relations.evidence: He also served as the principal of Buddhist school Mahinda College, Galle in Ceylon for 16 years from 1903 to 1919.

relations.subject: Frank Lee Woodward
relations.evidence: Woodward joined the London Theosophical Society in 1902, and became a friend and follower of Col. Henry Steel Olcott
